campuses.title: FAD Dubai Campus
campuses.text: Главный кампус FAD в Дубае — студии fashion design, styling, image design, photography и interior design в творческом квартале Al Quoz.

paragraphs: FAD Institute of Luxury Fashion & Style is a specialised design school focused on fashion, styling, luxury brand management, and creative industries. Founded in 2002 by industry veteran Sandeep Kapoor, FAD operates campuses across India and the UAE, with the Dubai studio positioned at the centre of the Middle East luxury market.

The Dubai campus offers BA (Hons) degrees in Fashion Design, Fashion Styling & Image Design, Fashion Business & Marketing, and Interior Design, alongside an MA in Luxury Brand Management and a suite of diploma programmes in styling, jewellery, makeup artistry, photography, and merchandising.

FAD's pedagogy is studio-led and industry-embedded: students work on live briefs with regional brands, mall groups, and luxury houses, and graduate with a portfolio plus a network rooted in the Dubai fashion week and retail ecosystem.
International students from India, the GCC, Africa, and CIS countries form a diverse cohort. Admission is portfolio-led; IELTS 6.0 is the standard language benchmark for English-taught programmes.
paragraphsRu: FAD Institute of Luxury Fashion & Style — специализированная школа дизайна, фокус на fashion, styling, luxury brand management и creative industries. Основана в 2002 году индустриальным ветераном Sandeep Kapoor, FAD имеет кампусы в Индии и UAE; студия в Дубае находится в центре ближневосточного luxury-рынка.

Кампус в Дубае предлагает BA (Hons) по Fashion Design, Fashion Styling & Image Design, Fashion Business & Marketing и Interior Design, а также MA Luxury Brand Management и набор diploma-программ по styling, jewellery, makeup artistry, photography и merchandising.

Педагогика FAD — studio-led и индустриально встроенная: студенты работают над live-брифами с региональными брендами, mall-группами и luxury-домами, и выпускаются с портфолио и сетью контактов в Dubai Fashion Week и retail-экосистеме.
Международные студенты из Индии, GCC, Африки и СНГ формируют diverse-cohort. Поступление — по портфолио; IELTS 6.0 — стандартный языковой бенчмарк для англоязычных программ.
